globalBoundaries: Buyer-use interpretation of published Australian specifications, not a road test, handling judgement, safety outcome or whole-vehicle recommendation.
WLTP is a laboratory comparison cycle; retain exact trim, specification epoch and standard-wheel scope. It is not real-world, motorway or laden range.
Peak DC rates are advertised vehicle maxima only where established, not sustained rates. Preserve exact SOC windows, charging conditions and test-charger versus vehicle-rating distinctions.
Current named configuration, accepted factory order, live NEW advertisement and physically available unsold stock are separate states.
Formal manufacturer MY, technical document MY/date, delivered VIN epoch and dealer build/calendar/MY labels remain separate. A brochure filename or dealer headline cannot fill a formal MY null.
Unknown is not absent, false or zero. Do not inherit another trim, historical epoch, hybrid powertrain, overseas feature or generic dealer-template specification.
Cargo figures retain seating/loading-height and measurement basis. Never rank unlike or unspecified cargo measurements.
No prices, warranty, availability guarantees, autonomous-driving or market-leading claims in lead copy. Main agent alone edits application; Model Y hero9 is outside scope.
